title: Innodata vs. SoundHound AI: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
author: Anders Bylund
description: The article compares two AI-focused technology stocks: Innodata, which provides data engineering services for large language models with 47.6% revenue growth and profitability, versus SoundHound AI, which offers conversational AI platforms with 99.4% revenue growth but ongoing losses and negative cash flow. Despite Innodata's stronger financial metrics and lower valuation, the author recommends SoundHound AI as the better long-term buy due to its massive addressable market, recent LivePerson acquisition, and potential path to profitability, though acknowledging it carries higher risk.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Profitable with strong 47.6% revenue growth and healthy balance sheet, but faces significant risk from 58% customer concentration (potentially Meta), legal issues, and potential in-house competition from major tech clients. Conservatively valued but growth concerns limit upside.

title: SoundHound AI, Inc. (SOUN) Declines More Than Market: Some Information for Investors
author: Zacks.Com
description: SoundHound AI (SOUN) closed at $6.01, down 1.8%, underperforming the S&P 500's 0.76% decline. The stock has fallen 13.19% over the past month while the broader market gained. Despite revenue growth projections of 48.47% for the upcoming quarter and 41.02% for the full year, the company is expected to report negative earnings of -$0.06 per share (down 100% YoY) and -$0.18 for the full year. SOUN currently holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The stock has significantly underperformed the market, declining 13.19% in the past month versus the S&P 500's 1.26% gain. More critically, the company is projected to report negative earnings per share for both the upcoming quarter (-$0.06, down 100% YoY) and full year (-$0.18, down 38.46% YoY), indicating profitability challenges despite strong revenue growth expectations.

title: SoundHound Expands in Banking: Can AI Agents Win Regulated Markets?
author: Na
description: SoundHound AI (SOUN) is expanding its presence in banking and financial services by renewing/expanding contracts with major banks and insurers. The company's OASYS platform combines guardrails and evaluation tools for secure financial workflows. Q2 revenues grew 45% to $61.9M, though adjusted EBITDA remained a $9.6M loss. The company faces intensifying competition from NICE and Five9 in the regulated financial services AI market.

title: Alianza Crux™ to Power the Era of Cognitive Communications
author: Not Specified
description: Alianza launched Alianza Crux, an orchestration and intelligence control plane designed to integrate AI-powered experiences with telecom networks. The platform enables multiple AI applications to participate in a single conversation while maintaining network security, identity, and policy controls. According to HyperFRAME Research, 44% of telecom operators are losing subscribers to AI-enabled competitors, highlighting the need for intelligent network solutions. Alianza Crux is available through controlled release with broader commercial availability planned for H1 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: SoundHound AI is highlighted as an experience provider partner benefiting from Alianza Crux. The platform eliminates implementation friction for their customers, enabling faster deployment of voice AI experiences without legacy telecom configuration challenges, which should improve their market competitiveness and customer acquisition.
